title: Microsoft extends paid incident and security fix support for Windows NT 4.0 Server to the end of 2004
impact: NT 4.0 servers get one more year of security fixes, but non-security fixes still end in 2003, so migration plans gain only a little slack

title: .NET Framework 1.1 ships with Visual Studio .NET 2003 and Windows Server 2003
impact: Targeting 1.1 requires Visual Studio .NET 2003; 1.1 adds ODBC and Oracle data providers and is built into Windows Server 2003

title: Visual Basic .NET 2003 (VB 7.1) ships with Visual Studio .NET 2003
impact: Loop variables can be declared in For statements and bit shift operators become available, only with Visual Studio .NET 2003 or later

markers.name: For loop variable declared in the statement

title: Windows Server 2003 ships
impact: New servers for file sharing, databases and IIS 6.0 web apps can be built on it; IIS 6.0 runs ASP.NET in application pools

title: Windows Server 2003 ships with extended support scheduled to end in July 2015
impact: Servers bought for 2003 have a known end date, so server replacement and app moves to a newer Windows can be planned years ahead

title: .NET Framework 1.1 ships with support that ends in October 2013 under Microsoft's lifecycle policy
impact: Apps on the 1.1 runtime have a known end date, so a move to a later framework can be planned years ahead

title: Visual Studio .NET 2003 ships
impact: Opening a 2002 solution converts it one way to the 2003 format, and the IDE builds only for .NET Framework 1.1, so the whole team has to upgrade together

markers.name: solution format 8.00

title: Visual Studio .NET 2003 ships with extended support scheduled to end in October 2013
impact: Teams building with Visual Studio .NET 2003 have a known end date for the IDE, so the next IDE upgrade can be planned

title: Crystal Reports for Visual Studio .NET 2003 is bundled with Visual Studio .NET 2003
impact: Report projects move with the IDE to version 9.1.5000, and the matching runtime merge modules have to be redeployed with the app

title: Office 2003 becomes available
impact: Excel stays on .xls with 65,536 rows per sheet and Access on Jet 4.0 .mdb files; .NET apps automate Office through the primary interop assemblies, which tie the build to the Office version on each PC

title: Office 2003 becomes available with extended support scheduled to end in April 2014
impact: PCs moved to Office 2003 have a known end date, so the next Office upgrade and retesting of Excel and Access integrations can be planned
